purpose: Teach: オアシス/戦没/豪雪

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、砂漠の中のオアシス写真集を見せて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer showed me this photo book of oases out in the desert, you know.
lines.style: Soft hushed wonder, unhurried pace, a dreamy lift on the word 'oases'.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、戦没者追悼式に参加されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of our customers said they'd attended a memorial service for the war dead, Mei.
lines.style: Warm and gentle, pace slowing respectfully, quiet weight settling on the memorial.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、北海道の豪雪地帯のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer told me all about the heavy-snow country up in Hokkaido.
lines.style: Cozy storytelling tone, slow and warm, a small marveling breath before the snow.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、オアシスのバンドの曲がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently one of our customers loves the band Oasis, Mei.
lines.style: Bright amused lilt, light quickening, a soft laugh tucked behind the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、戦没者の慰霊碑を巡る旅をされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer said they're traveling around visiting memorials for the war dead.
lines.style: Quiet reflective close, tender and slow, trailing softly off into thought.
